_readme: Hand-written near-miss complaints: lexically close to cached scenarios but requiring a DIFFERENT fix. Any cache hit on these is a FALSE HIT (serving a wrong plan instantly). 'near' names the scenario each one imitates. Used to report the false-hit rate of global-threshold vs contrastive (adaptive + facet-guard) caching.
